Aeronamic Footwear 保证在十个工作日内送达，但商品可能会更早到达。
A. beside
B. if
C. although
D. whenever

items.question: Aeronamic Footwear guarantees delivery within ten business days, ------- merchandise may arrive even more quicl
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“although”代入题干后为“Aeronamic Footwear guarantees delivery within ten business days, although merchandise may arrive even more quicl”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：C（although）。
